summary: Section 482 CrPC; further investigation vs reinvestigation; District Police Chief lacks authority to order further investigation without Magistrate's permission; supplementary report invalidly filed post-closure; no evidence of financial transactions or specific role of appellant; ingredients of Section 420 IPC not met; High Court erred in not quashing proceedings; closure report (FR-I) indicating false case not acted upon; challenge to validity of FR-II based on unauthorized further investigation.
legal_provisions_cited: Minu Kumari v. State of Bihar
Devendra Nath Singh v. State of Bihar
Paramjit Batra v. State of Uttarakhand
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order of High Court setting aside quashing petition is quashed; proceedings under Criminal Case No. 1326/2017 directed to be quashed; FR-II set aside as unauthorized; trial court to consider FR-I as final.
